title: Profinite Borel completeness and smooth Artin motives
summary: The purpose of this paper is twofold. In the first part, we revisit the description of the $\infty$-category of Borel complete equivariant spectra for a finite group given by Mathew-Naumann-Noel, introduce a version with coefficients, and then consider Borel equivariance for profinite groups. Here we identify two generally differing notions: levelwise Borel completeness and the hypercompletion thereof.
